descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} manages to explore some areas of the abandoned temple but struggles with the magical traps and guardians. Finds a few minor artifacts but the cautious approach limits the rewards from the expedition.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} successfully raids the abandoned temple. Skillfully avoids magical traps, outmaneuvers ancient guardians, and emerges with valuable relics and treasures from the forgotten sanctuary.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} becomes a legendary temple raider with this expedition. Perfectly navigates all magical defenses, discovers secret chambers, and returns with rare artifacts and treasures that make them renowned among treasure hunters.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} helps uncover hidden treasures in the temple.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} reveals the crypt's greatest secrets.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} discovers an ancient crypt but struggles with its complex defenses. The traps and mechanisms prove too advanced, forcing a retreat with exhaustion and no treasures from the failed discovery.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} manages to explore parts of the ancient crypt but finds it heavily trapped. Carefully navigates some areas and finds moderate treasures, but the difficulty limits the full potential of the discovery.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} successfully explores the ancient crypt. Skillfully navigates all traps, solves complex mechanisms, and emerges with valuable ancient treasures and artifacts from the forgotten burial site.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} becomes a master crypt explorer with this discovery. Perfectly navigates every trap, unlocks secret chambers, and returns with legendary treasures and artifacts that make them famous among treasure hunters.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} reveals the crypt's greatest secrets.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} shows in tools that actually fit the job.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} leaves a pry bar wrong, a line frayed, or a lamp badly seated. The mistake is small on a bench and huge in a dark corridor.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} replaces what was worn and oils what was sticking. The kit returns to baseline—no miracles, no surprises.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} sets up a trap-kit that feels unfairly calm: picks seat true, cordage runs clean, and backups sit where panic will not have to search.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} builds a setup other hunters borrow without asking. Every piece has a reason, every repair has a story, and the whole pack looks ready for stone that bites back.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} shows in tools that actually fit the job.
daily_stories.trait_msg_failure: {worker_name}'s {trait} did not help at the bench today.

daily_stories.description: {worker_name} tears into the ruins with reckless urgency — checking traps feels like a waste of time when the blood is running this hot.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} skips the usual trap checks and charges straight into a burial chamber. A pressure plate triggers a volley of poisoned darts, and the desperate scramble to escape brings down a section of ceiling. Crawls out empty-handed, bleeding, and still burning.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} rushes through corridors that deserve patience, jimmying locks with shaking hands and rifling through chests without cataloguing. A few trinkets are recovered, but a sealed vault is missed entirely because the impatient search pattern skipped the hidden passage.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} channels feverish energy into relentless, focused excavation. Tunnels that would take a day are cleared in hours, traps are disarmed with aggressive efficiency, and an overlooked side chamber yields a cache of old coins. The impatience, for once, pays off.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} tears through the ruin like a force of nature. The frantic pace somehow puts them one step ahead of every trap, and the instinct-driven search pattern leads straight to the main treasure vault. A haul that would take a careful team a week is dragged home in a single feverish day. The guild appraiser's eyes widen.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} turns reckless urgency into treasure-finding instinct.

professions.name: Boss Hunting
professions.description: Hunts legendary mythical beasts. Extreme risk with the highest rewards. Can obtain rare loot and legendary materials. Very dangerous.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s legendary {trait} proves essential in the hunt.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} tracks and confronts the mythical beast, but the legendary creature proves too powerful. The dragon's ancient wisdom, the chimera's ferocious might, or the hydra's regenerative power overwhelms even the most skilled hunter. A desperate retreat is the only option, leaving severe wounds and a humbling reminder of the true power of mythical creatures.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} engages the mythical beast in an epic battle that tests every skill. The fight is brutal and exhausting - while the creature is wounded and driven off, the hunter returns with significant injuries and only minor trophies. The beast lives to fight another day, but the encounter proves the hunter's courage.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} achieves the legendary feat of slaying a mythical beast. Through masterful strategy, exceptional combat prowess, and unbreakable determination, brings down the dragon, chimera, or hydra. Returns with valuable scales, horns, claws, and other legendary materials that prove the impossible kill, becoming a legend in the guild.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} transcends mortal limits by flawlessly executing the mythical beast hunt. The perfect strategy, god-like combat mastery, and complete domination of the legendary creature creates an epic tale that will be told for generations. Returns with treasures beyond mortal comprehension - dragon scales that shimmer with inner fire, chimera pelts of impossible beauty, or hydra hearts that pulse with ancient power.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s legendary {trait} proves essential in the hunt.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} keeps the approach honest and the exit real.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} misreads the ground and pays for it in scrapes, lost time, and a route that ends where pride hoped it would not. The notes are more warning than help.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} maps the approach well enough to stop stupid mistakes. Peaks, washes, and blind corners are marked in plain ink—useful, unromantic, done.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} returns with lines that respect gravity and weather. The approach reads like someone planned to run it twice—once to learn, once to survive.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} charts a path that feels unfairly clean: cover, timing, and retreat slots where panic will not have to invent them. Even cynics bookmark the page.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} keeps the approach honest and the exit real.
daily_stories.trait_msg_failure: {worker_name}'s {trait} did not help the recon today.

daily_stories.description: {worker_name} picks the most dangerous contract on the board — the kind nobody sane takes alone — and sets out before dawn with a grin that worries the quartermaster.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} charges the legendary beast head-on, ignoring every tactical opening. The creature barely has to try — a single swipe sends {worker_name} tumbling down a ravine. Crawling back to the guild battered and empty-handed, the healers mutter about a death wish.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} fights with reckless fury that occasionally connects. The beast takes wounds but refuses to fall, and {worker_name}'s stamina burns out before the kill. A tactical retreat with minor trophies — a fang, a patch of hide — but the bounty goes unclaimed.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} throws everything at the beast with a ferocity that catches it off guard. The usual caution is replaced by relentless aggression that, against all reason, works. The monster falls hard and fast. {worker_name} drags the carcass home drenched in blood and finally, blessedly calm.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} fights like something out of legend — a blur of steel and primal rage that the beast simply cannot match. The kill is savage, efficient, and terrifyingly beautiful. The guild master pins the contract receipt to the wall of fame, and the bounty is the largest payout of the season.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} turns suicidal bravery into a legendary kill.
daily_stories.trait_msg_failure: {worker_name}'s {trait} made the reckless charge nearly fatal.

professions.name: Monster Taming
professions.description: Captures and tames wild monsters to recruit them as workers. Can use combat prowess to subdue creatures through force, or seductive charm to lure them through primal attraction. High risk profession that expands your workforce with unique monster servants.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} makes the capture particularly effective.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} attempts to capture a monster but the creature proves too wild and dangerous. The failed expedition sets back the guild's monster acquisition efforts and leaves the team wounded and discouraged.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} makes some progress in monster capture operations. While no new creatures are successfully brought back, valuable intelligence is gathered and preparations are made for future capture attempts.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} advances the guild's monster servant program significantly. Either captures a new creature or makes extraordinary progress in taming and training existing monsters, bringing the guild closer to its goals.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} achieves a breakthrough in monster capture operations. Successfully brings back a powerful new servant creature or completes the training of multiple monsters, dramatically expanding the guild's supernatural workforce.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} makes the capture particularly effective.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} makes them utterly mesmerizing to the wild creature.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} ventures into the wilderness to lure a wild creature with seductive displays. But the seduction works too well - instead of becoming docile, the beast's lust turns aggressive. {worker_name} loses control as the creature mounts them roughly, taking what it wants before disappearing into the forest. No servant gained, only bruises and shame.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} finds a suitable monster and begins an enticing display - slow movements, exposed skin, alluring scents. The creature approaches, sniffing curiously, clearly attracted but ultimately too wild to be tamed. It circles {worker_name} with obvious desire before wandering off, leaving the seduction incomplete.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} locates a territorial werewolf and begins an irresistible seduction dance. The beast's rage transforms into fascination as {worker_name} moves sensually, teasing with glimpses of bare flesh. The creature becomes entranced, following every movement with hungry eyes. By maintaining the tension of unfulfilled desire, {worker_name} leads the captivated beast back - a new devoted servant, forever chasing the promise of pleasure.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} achieves legendary status among monster tamers. A fearsome dragon-kin discovers {worker_name} performing an ancient fertility dance in its lair. The creature is utterly mesmerized, its predatory instincts overwritten by overwhelming attraction. {worker_name} teases the beast to the edge of madness with promises of intimacy, binding it through desperate unfulfilled desire. The creature now follows with obsessive devotion, forever addicted to {worker_name}'s presence.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} makes them utterly mesmerizing to the wild creature.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} shows in knots, gates, and doses measured twice.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} leaves a latch stiff, a line uneven, or a dose sloppy. The rig looks ready until stress proves it is not, and the guild sends it back to the bench.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} brings the rig back to honest function. Nothing sings, nothing snaps, and the next attempt starts without a stupid handicap.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} builds capture gear that respects teeth, claws, and panic. Everything releases clean, everything tightens on purpose, and the work reads like patience with tools.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} assembles a setup other tamers copy without shame: clever tension, redundant safety, and small touches that keep blood off the contract line.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} shows in knots, gates, and doses measured twice.
daily_stories.trait_msg_failure: {worker_name}'s {trait} did not help the rig work today.

daily_stories.description: {worker_name} radiates a feral, restless energy that the creatures in the pen can smell — it either draws them closer or drives them wild.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name}'s pheromone-drenched approach confuses a territorial drake into a mating display that ends with {worker_name} pinned under three hundred pounds of amorous scales. The handlers have to pry them apart, and the creature is more agitated than before. No taming today.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} gets close enough to a wild beast to begin the bonding ritual, but the restless energy makes the movements too jerky, too unpredictable. The creature circles warily, occasionally nuzzling before snapping and retreating. Half-tamed at best — it'll need another session.
descriptions.success: {worker_name}'s primal energy resonates with the creature on an instinctive level. The beast approaches without fear, drawn by something it recognises in {worker_name}'s scent and body language. The bonding clicks into place faster than anyone expected. A clean capture with minimal sedative.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} walks into the wild den radiating such raw, animalistic authority that the target creature simply... submits. No fight, no chase, no sedative. It follows {worker_name} home like it's been waiting its whole life for someone who speaks its language. The handlers watch in stunned silence. A perfect bond.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} creates a primal connection the creature can't resist.
daily_stories.trait_msg_failure: {worker_name}'s {trait} sent the wrong signal to the beast.

professions.name: Manager
professions.description: Helps manage the business operations. Each manager reduces the chance of daily events by 10%, stacking across all your buildings.

daily_stories.trait_success: The guild benefits from {worker_name}'s {trait} management.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} fails to manage the guild effectively. Poor organization and lack of leadership create chaos, disappointing both adventurers and clients.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} manages the guild adequately but without inspiration. Basic operations run smoothly but nothing exceptional happens.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} manages the guild with skill and professionalism. The establishment runs smoothly, adventurers are organized, and contracts are fulfilled efficiently.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} excels as a manager, creating an exceptional guild experience. Perfect organization, inspired leadership, and attention to detail make the guild legendary.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: The guild benefits from {worker_name}'s {trait} management.

daily_stories.description: {worker_name} can't concentrate on the fine print — signs contracts with shaking hands and approves expeditions without proper risk assessment.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} accepts a contract from a suspiciously generous client without reading the kill clause. The guild sends a team into a nest that turns out to be three times the reported size. Casualties, compensation claims, and a furious guild master. {worker_name} spends the evening being yelled at instead of doing anything about the ache.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} processes contracts at double speed to get away from the desk, skimming where they should study. A few unfavourable terms slip through — lower bounties, higher liability — nothing ruinous, but the adventurers grumble when they see the fine print.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} turns restless energy into ruthless contract negotiation. Too wired to be patient, but too sharp to be careless — every clause is challenged, every bounty pushed higher, every risk properly assessed. Clients leave feeling slightly fleeced, and the guild's cut is the best it's been all month.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} negotiates like someone possessed. A merchant guild that came in expecting to lowball the adventurers leaves having agreed to premium rates, exclusive supply contracts, and a retainer that covers three months of guild expenses. The adventurers toast {worker_name}'s name at the tavern that evening.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} turns impatience into aggressive deal-making.

professions.name: Rest
professions.description: Worker takes a break to regenerate health and energy. No daily events occur, allowing recovery without risk.

daily_stories.description: The worker takes a break in the guild break room, regenerating health and energy without a roll.
{worker_name} took private time to release tension and returned calmer for the next day.

building_types.name: Tavern
building_types.skill_description: Luxurious furnishings, comfortable beds, and welcoming atmospheres that make guests feel at home. Enhanced accommodations help your innkeepers handle difficult guests and create memorable experiences. Formula: Base Level + Skill Bonus = Success chance in Events.

professions.name: Bartender
professions.description: Serves drinks and tends the bar. Generates steady income through beverage service. Keeps customers happy and coming back.

daily_stories.trait_success: The client is delighted by {worker_name}'s {trait}.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} struggles behind the bar, spilling drinks and mixing up orders. The poor service and lack of tavern atmosphere management disappoints patrons who expected better hospitality.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} handles basic bartending duties competently but lacks the flair that makes a tavern memorable. Serves drinks adequately but doesn't create the lively atmosphere that keeps customers coming back.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} creates a welcoming tavern atmosphere while expertly mixing drinks. The combination of skilled bartending and engaging conversation makes patrons feel at home and eager to return.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} transforms the tavern into the heart of the community. Masterful drink crafting, entertaining stories, and perfect crowd management create such a vibrant atmosphere that the tavern becomes legendary.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: The client is delighted by {worker_name}'s {trait}.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} helps defuse the violent situation.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} watches helplessly as a disagreement between two drunk mercenaries explodes into a full tavern brawl. Tables shatter, bottles fly, and by the time the city guard arrives, the bar looks like a warzone. {worker_name} catches an elbow to the face trying to intervene too late, and the night's earnings are spent on repairs.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} tries to step between the fighters but gets shoved aside. Eventually talks the less drunk one into backing down, but not before a table and several chairs are destroyed. The other patrons clear out early, killing the evening's revenue.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} reads the tension building between two groups of adventurers and acts before fists fly. Steps in with a firm voice and a free round, redirecting the aggression into a drinking contest instead. The night ends louder than usual, but profitable and with the furniture intact.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} handles the erupting brawl like a veteran peacekeeper. Catches the first thrown punch mid-swing by slamming a mug on the bar so hard the whole room freezes. Talks both sides down with a mix of humor and steel-eyed authority, then sells them twice as much ale as they'd normally drink. The tavern earns more than a usual night, and both groups leave as friends.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} helps defuse the violent situation.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} helps navigate the stranger's cryptic requests.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} tries to serve the hooded stranger who appeared at closing time, but something about the figure's cold, unblinking stare makes every movement clumsy. The stranger orders a drink that doesn't exist, and when {worker_name} admits ignorance, the figure stands without a word and leaves a single copper coin on the bar - an insult that feels oddly threatening.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} serves the cloaked stranger adequately but can't crack their silence. The figure drinks alone, pays fairly, and vanishes into the night. {worker_name} finds a strange symbol scratched into the bar where they sat, but nothing comes of it.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} engages the mysterious traveler with the right balance of curiosity and discretion. Over several drinks, the stranger opens up enough to share tales from distant lands and leaves a generous purse of foreign gold. The stories attract other patrons who stay late to listen.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} recognizes the cloaked figure as someone of real importance - a disguised noble, a wandering archmage, or perhaps something stranger. Through careful conversation and perfect hospitality, {worker_name} earns the stranger's trust and a significant reward, along with a cryptic promise that 'this establishment will be remembered when the time comes.'

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} helps navigate the stranger's cryptic requests.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} makes the late-night encounter irresistible.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} tries to reciprocate when the last patron - a handsome mercenary - leans across the bar and brushes their hand. But the nervous fumbling that follows is painful. {worker_name} knocks over a bottle reaching for them, the kiss is all teeth, and by the time they get behind the bar together the mood is dead. The mercenary leaves with an apologetic smile and {worker_name} cleans up alone, frustrated and unsatisfied.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} lets the attractive stranger stay past closing. They end up pressed against the back wall of the stockroom, kissing hungrily, but it's rushed and awkward. The stranger's hands are rough and impatient, {worker_name} can't find a comfortable angle, and the whole thing ends with a quick, unsatisfying fuck standing up between the ale barrels. The stranger leaves a few coins on the bar.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} has been eyeing the dark-haired regular all evening, and when the last patron leaves, neither pretends there's any other reason to stay. They come together behind the bar, {worker_name} pressed against the counter, the stranger's mouth hot on their neck while hands work clothing loose. {worker_name} wraps their legs around the stranger's waist and they fuck right there, slow and deep, the empty tavern echoing with gasps. Afterward, the stranger leaves a heavy purse and a promise to come back tomorrow.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} doesn't even wait for the door to close behind the last customer. Pulls the muscular traveler behind the bar by their collar and kisses them hard. What follows is an hour of increasingly intense sex - bent over the bar, on the floor between the tables, against the stockroom door. {worker_name} rides them until they're both shaking, then lets the traveler take them from behind while they grip the bar rail. The stranger is so thoroughly satisfied they leave enough gold to cover the tavern's earnings for a week, and word of the tavern's 'hospitality' brings curious new patrons.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} makes the late-night encounter irresistible.

daily_stories.description: {worker_name} is so worked up they openly flirt and escalate with patrons right on the tavern floor.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name}'s lack of restraint causes disruptions at the bar. Drinks slosh, orders vanish, and the heated flirting that was meant to charm a table of soldiers instead starts a jealous argument. Management steps in before fists fly.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} keeps things mostly functional, but the openly heated behaviour distracts staff and patrons alike. Drinks pour slow, banter veers too personal, and the kitchen sends a runner to ask if the bartender plans to work tonight.
descriptions.success: {worker_name}'s bold, uninhibited energy excites the room and drives heavy ordering. Leaning across the bar with flushed cheeks and dangerous smiles, every patron feels like the chosen one. Tabs run long and nobody complains about the wait.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} commands the entire bar with shameless confidence, turning the night into a notorious spectacle that packs the tavern. Tips pile up, strangers buy rounds for the house, and by closing time the word on the street is that this is the only tavern worth visiting.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} turns restless energy into magnetic bar presence.
daily_stories.trait_msg_failure: {worker_name}'s {trait} couldn't keep the chaos from spilling over.

professions.name: Entertainer
professions.description: Entertains tavern guests through conversation, dance, music, storytelling, or other talents. Generates money by captivating audiences. Can entertain VIP guests for higher earnings.

daily_stories.trait_success: The crowd is delighted by {worker_name}'s {trait} during their entertainment.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} struggles to capture the tavern crowd's attention. Whether through conversation, dance, or other talents, their efforts lack energy and presence, leaving the rowdy patrons unimpressed and calling for better entertainment.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} provides decent entertainment for the tavern regulars but nothing that stands out. Their conversation, performance, or display of talent gets some appreciation but doesn't create the electric atmosphere that makes a tavern night memorable.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} captivates the tavern with their charm, whether through engaging conversation, graceful dance, musical talent, or other skills. The crowd gets into it, responding enthusiastically and creating the kind of night that brings people back.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} becomes the star of the tavern with an absolutely captivating display of talent. Whether through mesmerizing conversation, breathtaking dance, enchanting music, or other extraordinary skills, the entire crowd is spellbound, making the tavern the talk of the town.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: The crowd is delighted by {worker_name}'s {trait} during their entertainment.

daily_stories.trait_success: The VIP guests are mesmerized by {worker_name}'s {trait} during their entertainment.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} fails to meet the sophisticated expectations of the VIP guests. Whether through conversation, dance, or other talents, their efforts lack the refinement and exclusivity that the wealthy audience expects, disappointing the high-paying patrons.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} provides adequate entertainment for the VIP section but nothing that justifies the premium prices. Their conversation, performance, or display of talent is competent but lacks the special touch that makes VIP experiences memorable for the distinguished audience.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} delivers elegant entertainment perfectly suited for the tavern's VIP clientele. Through refined conversation, graceful dance, sophisticated music, or other refined talents, they captivate the wealthy audience and create exactly the refined experience that discerning patrons seek.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} creates an absolutely stunning VIP experience that exceeds all expectations. Whether through mesmerizing conversation, breathtaking artistry, or extraordinary talent, the entertainment is so captivating and exclusive that the entire wealthy audience considers it the finest they've ever witnessed.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: The VIP guests are mesmerized by {worker_name}'s {trait} during their entertainment.

daily_stories.trait_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} turns the heckler into part of the show.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} loses control of the room when a loud drunk starts mocking their performance. Every attempt to continue is drowned out by crude jokes and jeers. The heckler's friends join in, the crowd turns hostile, and {worker_name} leaves the stage humiliated, fighting back tears while the tavern's atmosphere is ruined for the night.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} tries to ignore the persistent heckler but the interruptions keep breaking the flow. Manages to finish the set but the energy in the room is flat. A few sympathetic patrons tip anyway, but most leave early, and {worker_name} feels drained and frustrated.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} handles the heckler like a seasoned performer. When the drunk shouts an insult, {worker_name} fires back with a razor-sharp comeback that gets the whole tavern roaring with laughter. The heckler shrinks in his seat, and the crowd rallies behind {worker_name} for the rest of the night.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} doesn't just shut the heckler down - they turn him into the best part of the show. Every interruption becomes fuel for improvised comedy so brilliant that even the heckler ends up laughing and buying rounds for the house. The crowd is in stitches, tips rain down, and the night becomes legendary tavern lore.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: {worker_name}'s {trait} turns the heckler into part of the show.

daily_stories.trait_success: The noble is utterly entranced by {worker_name}'s {trait}.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} accepts the noble's invitation to perform privately in the upstairs room, but freezes when the noble's hand slides up their thigh mid-song. The performance crumbles, {worker_name} stammers through an excuse and flees the room. The noble is furious at being refused after paying for the 'full experience' and threatens to ruin the tavern's reputation.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name} dances for the noble in the private room, letting clothes fall away piece by piece. But when the noble pulls them onto their lap, {worker_name}'s rhythm falters. The sex that follows is functional but uninspired - the noble gets off, {worker_name} goes through the motions. The payment is fair but the noble won't be requesting a private show again.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} gives the noble exactly the escalation they're craving. Starts with a slow, teasing dance, peeling away garments one by one while maintaining eye contact. When the noble can't take any more, {worker_name} straddles them in the velvet chair and rides them with the same rhythm as the dance - controlled, sensual, building. The noble comes undone completely, moaning {worker_name}'s name, and pays triple the agreed price.
descriptions.critical_success: {worker_name} delivers a private performance that blurs the line between art and pure carnality. The dance starts slow, hypnotic, every movement designed to drive the noble mad with want. By the time {worker_name} is naked and straddling the noble, the aristocrat is begging. What follows is an extended session where {worker_name} controls every moment - riding, grinding, whispering filth into the noble's ear between kisses. The noble climaxes so hard they nearly pass out, then books {worker_name} for every visit to the city, paying an exclusive retainer that dwarfs normal earnings.

daily_stories.trait_msg_success: The noble is utterly entranced by {worker_name}'s {trait}.

daily_stories.description: {worker_name}'s act takes a turn — every song, story, and gesture drips with barely-contained want.

descriptions.failure: {worker_name} tries to channel the heat into the performance but it comes across as desperate rather than daring. The ballad turns into an awkward overshare, the dance is more stumble than sway, and patrons shift in their seats. A few walk out.
descriptions.mediocre: {worker_name}'s act runs hotter than usual — loaded glances at the audience, lyrics twisted toward innuendo, movements that linger on the edge of scandalous. Some patrons lean in; others order another round to cope. The effect is mixed.
descriptions.success: {worker_name} weaves raw desire into every note and gesture. The performance is magnetic — a love song that makes couples grip each other's hands, a dance that stops conversation mid-sentence. The crowd throws coin and demands an encore.
